;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[November 2018 Kabul attack]]
**At least 50 people are killed and 83 others injured in a suicide bombing on a [[Mawlid]] gathering in [[Kabul]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-46273612 (BBC)]
[[2018 Brussels stabbing attack]]
*A policeman is stabbed near the Grand Place in [[Brussels]] historic centre by a man carrying two small kitchen knives. The attacker is shot in the chest and in a critical condition while the policeman suffers non-life threatening injuries. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/policeman-stabbed-brussels-attacker-shot-59309779 (ABCNEWS)]

;Disasters and accidents
*One person is killed and six others are injured after a train derails due to a landslide in the [[Catalonia]]n town of [[Vacarisses]], [[Province of Barcelona]]. [https://edition-m.cnn.com/2018/11/20/europe/barcelona-train-derailment-intl/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations
*The general assembly of [[Interpol]] elects [[Vanuatu]] and [[Kiribati]] as new members, but not [[Kosovo]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/kosovos-application-for-interpol-membership-rejected/2018/11/20/f6a70dc8-ecaf-11e8-8b47-bd0975fd6199_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] 
*[[Poland]] and [[Israel]] join [[Bulgaria]], the [[Czech Republic]], [[Croatia]], [[Hungary]], [[Australia]] and [[Austria]] in announcing that, despite their agreement in July, they will not sign the [[United Nations]] [[Global Compact for Migration]] in [[Marrakech]] on 10–11 December 2018. [https://www.foxnews.com/world/the-latest-poland-withdraws-from-global-migration-pact (Fox News)] [https://www.yenisafak.com/en/world/polands-government-rejects-un-migration-pact-3466921 (''Yeni Şafak'')] [https://www.jpost.com/Israel-News/Israel-joins-US-and-European-countries-in-pulling-out-of-migration-pact-572361 (''Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Erik Solheim]] resigns as head of the [[United Nations Environment Programme]] over allegations of expenses abuse and a lack of accountability. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-46281051 (BBC News)]
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[North Korea]] blows up ten of its front-line guard posts in the [[Korean Demilitarized Zone]] (DMZ) in accordance with agreements made with [[South Korea]] earlier this year. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/north-korea-detonates-dmz-guard-posts-southern-border/story?id=59314370 (ABC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Nikola Gruevski]], former [[Prime Minister of Macedonia]], says he is granted political asylum in [[Hungary]] after he fled his [[Republic of Macedonia|home country]] last week to avoid a two-and-a-half-year jail sentence for corruption. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/report-hungary-grants-asylum-to-former-macedonian-leader/2018/11/20/829acc40-ecd1-11e8-8b47-bd0975fd6199_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/nov/20/anti-asylum-orban-makes-exception-for-a-friend-in-need (''The Guardian'')]

;Politics and elections
*Disgruntled police officers and [[Papua New Guinea Defence Force|soldiers]] storm the [[National Parliament of Papua New Guinea]] due to unpaid allowances related to the [[APEC Papua New Guinea 2018]] conference last weekend. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/nov/20/papua-new-guinea-parliament-in-lockdown-after-soldiers-attack-building (''The Guardian'')]
*The [[European Union]] reaches a provisional agreement on a system to investigate [[Foreign direct investment|foreign investment]]s into Europe. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-china-investment/eu-reaches-provisional-deal-on-screening-foreign-investments-idUSKCN1NP1IJ (Reuters)]
*[[Gilets jaunes protests]]
**[[France]]'s "Yellow Vest" protests over [[fuel tax]]es enter their fourth day as around 10,000 people continue to block roads around the country. [https://www.thelocal.fr/20181120/latest-yellow-vest-fuel-protests-enter-fourth-day-as-french-government-stands-firm (''The Local'')] 
*[[Ivanka Trump]], elder daughter of U.S. President [[Donald Trump]], is found to have used a private e-mail account to handle government business e-mails. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-46271021 (BBC)]
